newsitem.title: UK: Disney's "Beauty and Beast" set for London stage.
newsitem.headline: Disney's "Beauty and Beast" set for London stage.

text.p: Entertainment giant Walt Disney Co plans to launch a British production of its hit Broadway musical "Beauty and the Beast" in London next year, its producers said on Friday.

The 10 million pound ($16 million) show with 45 cast members and a 25-piece orchestra will be one of the most expensive musicials ever staged in the British capital when it opens on May 13, Stella Musical Productions said in a statement.
The Broadway show of the Disney animated film about a beautiful village girl who falls in love with a beast living in a magical castle opened in April 1994.
Casting for the show with music by Tim Rice and lyrics by the late American writer Howard Ashman has not been made yet.
Nine productions of the hit musical are currently playing around the world including Sydney, Tokyo, Toronto and Vienna. ($1=.6388 Pound)
